alex_r: quick heads-up — ran a small bring-up for speculative decoding + int8 quant on llama3-12b-q against our codegen mini-suite. big perf win but a small quality hit on exact-match. need quick triage.

ci-bot: CI job finished: job/rl-eval/4921 — artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/rl-eval/4921 (logs + samples) :white_check_mark:

maria_pm: what exact spec config? spec depth? sampling/topp/temp? dataset used?

alex_r: config pasted below:
```
MODEL=llama3-12b-q
QUANT=int8
SPEC_DEPTH=2   # speculative rolls per step
SAMPLER=top-p
P=0.92
BATCH=8
MAX_LEN=256
WARMUP=128   # prefix tokens for kv warmup
```
Quick numbers (mini-suite 120 prompts):
- latency p50 per token: 210ms -> 110ms (spec+int8)
- throughput: 0.55k tok/s -> 1.02k tok/s median (2x)
- code exact-match: 0.78 -> 0.71 (-0.07)
- ppl (heldout): 12.4 -> 12.9 (+0.5)

jon_ml: thanks. is the exact-match drop concentrated on long completions or on specific families (sql/snippets)? any pattern in top-1 vs top-k?

alex_r: initial look: regressions concentrated on multi-line python functions (docstrings + edge-case parsing). short snippets (<64 tokens) unaffected. top-1 alignment drops more than top-k (so sampling+spec interplay).

sophie_infra: did you run with or without prefix/KV prefetch? our spec pipeline mixes prefetch and lazy-kv and that can change generation order under int8.

alex_r: ran both. notes: with KV-prefetch enabled and warmup=128 we see the best latency but slightly worse exact-match. disabling prefetch reduces throughput to ~0.85k tok/s but exact-match recovers to ~0.74. suggests prefetch+spec introduces subtle timing/ordering that affects the sampler.

maria_pm: for evaluation methodology: can you 1) pin RNG seeds and sampling path for deterministic replay, 2) collect n-best lists for analysis (top 5), 3) run spec-depth ablation (0,1,2) on the failing prompt subset. that should isolate whether spec decisions or quant noise cause the shift.

alex_r: yes. planning to:
- rerun 0/1/2 spec depth with seed=42
- dump top-5 per prompt + token-level logits for 200 failing examples
- run decode with float16 baseline + int8 w/o speculative for sanity

ci-bot: Artifact note: logs include token timestamps and sampler seeds at s3://redwood-ci/rl-eval/4921/artifacts (step_logs.jsonl.gz)

jon_ml: also try lowering top-p to 0.88 for the spec runs — sometimes spec amplifies tail mass and top-p interacts weirdly with quantized logits. and check beam-collapse cases (repeated tokens).

maria_pm: add unit-level eval: run our style/regression harness (regression-suite-v2) to verify no safety regressions; we can't ship a perf trick that increases hallucinations.

deploy-bot: FYI: dedicated rollout policy requires <0.03 average drop on standard devsuite to proceed automatic canary. manual review otherwise.

alex_r: ack — action items: re-run ablations with pinned seeds, dump top-k and logits, run regression-suite-v2, try prefetch ablation + lower top-p. I'll post updated numbers by EOD PST. :thumbsup:

maria_pm: sounds good. if quality holds after ablations we can discuss a canary config (spec_depth=1, prefetch=off, quant=int8) as a config that trades some perf for less regressions.

alex_r: thanks — creating a ticket with artifacts and eta.
